decision: Full car = 'Honda S2000 AP1 Scans_1.stl' (10RVc_CUrggUkvuurjmfpdNAi0Sj4Avvm), not the suggested OBJ
why: Same Artec export: identical 24,975,039 triangles and the first 90k STL vertices equal OBJ vertices to <0.001 mm; the STL streams straight into ive decimate, no conversion needed

decision: Levelled the car with tools/level.py (PCA + 4-quadrant low points, nose -Y); one transform in /home/user/media/honda-s2000/lvl/level.json, canonical prep = prep/car4.json (every other scan prepped --like it)
why: Raw Artec frame is tilted arbitrarily and the car was scanned without wheels or ground, so there is no floor plane to level on; wheel-arch centres 2,400 mm apart = S2000 wheelbase confirms scale; drop-islands removed nose debris (4,458 -> 4,111 mm, spec 4,135)

decision: Front-end state scans (Front End, Hood Open, Bumper Removed, Bumper Only) registered with FPFH+RANSAC+ICP after removing the scanned floor, then zone ICP on hood+fender tops only (match/T_frontend_z.json)
why: They are in their own frame (300+ mm off). Hood/fender zone residual p50 1.47 mm, 87% <3 mm; Bumper Only sits 1.6 mm from Front End so all four share one frame and get one transform

decision: Bumper of the full-car scan is NOT used next to state-scan geometry; the front composites use the state scans as captured over the trimmed car
why: With hood/fenders locked, the state session's bumper sits ~25 mm further forward than the full-car bumper (centre-line and corner sections) - it was refitted between sessions; lesson: state scan as captured over the trimmed full car

decision: Not used: Scans_2 (loose bumper, inner+outer), Scans_3 (thin lip strip), AP1 S2000 SD.obj (5M-tri textured copy of the same car)
why: Scans_2 does not register to Bumper Only (fitness <5 %, pose changes per try) or anywhere on the car; Scans_3 is not a stock-car part and could be an aftermarket lip (brief: our scan data only, stock car); SD is a lower-res duplicate

decision: Panels cut from the full car with top-view outlines traced on a 2 mm ortho render along the visible seams (match/panels_px.json, tools/polypart.py): hood = topmost skin in the outline; trunk lid = outline AND missing from the trunk-open state scan
why: Diffing against Hood Open alone also grabbed the fender tops (that scan is partial); seams are crisp at 2 mm so a traced outline is exact, and the trunk diff keeps the fixed rear panel on the car

decision: State bases built with tools/comp.py: car minus panels + only NEW geometry of the state scans inside a zone (Bumper Removed for the front structure, Hood Open for the radiator support/bay, trunk scan for the trunk interior); the one scanned front wheel in Bumper Removed is boxed out
why: Lesson: state scan as captured over the trimmed full car; the full-car scan has no wheels, so a single scanned wheel would look like an error

decision: Trunk lid hinge fitted to the lid captured open in the trunk scan: axis X at y=1.529 z=0.874 m (prep), 77 deg (match/lid_hinge.json, median 10 mm on a sparse open-lid capture); hood hinge guessed at its rear edge (0,-0.31,0.83), opened only partly
why: Fitted hinge = physically right motion; no open-hood capture exists, and the engine bay behind the radiator support was never scanned (reads as a dark void), so the hood opens ~40 deg viewed from the front where the bay is in shadow

decision: Shot order: s1 front 3/4 turntable -> s2 rear 3/4 orbit -> s3 headlight ECU (2 mm) -> s4 tail-lamp ECU (2 mm) -> s5 front opens (bumper slides off the Bumper Removed structure, hood lifts) -> s6 trunk lid opens -> s7 high front 3/4 to top-down -> s8 exploded view -> logo
why: Brief = Temerario order (turntables/orbits, extreme close-ups, panels open where state scans allow, top-down, exploded view, logo); front + trunk are the two states the scans support

decision: Car shown without wheels (as scanned); cameras at 1.2-1.6 m and 3/4 angles rather than the reference's low side profile
why: The full car was scanned as a body shell with no wheels; low side views made the empty arches the subject (first preview). Only one front and one rear wheel exist in state scans, so adding wheels would be inconsistent/fabricated

decision: Framing tightened after the 30% preview: s5 orbit 5.2->4.2 m, s6 4.3->3.6 m, top-down 7.0->5.6 m; s4 framed higher
why: Preview sheet: car read small in 9:16 (lesson: tighten by cropping into the car); s4 bottom showed jagged exhaust-tip scan debris

decision: Exploded view: bumper (Bumper Only scan) +0.8 m up/0.5 m forward, hood +1.45 m, trunk lid +1.25 m, tilted toward the lens; base = car minus all three + Bumper Removed structure + Hood Open bay + trunk interior; high front-left 3/4 looking down ~30 deg, slow 32-deg orbit
why: Only three separable panels have scan data; three preview rounds: level camera showed hood/lid edge-on as slivers and the bumper left the 9:16 frame - stacking in layers above the car (reference 25-31 s) and a higher camera keeps all parts readable

decision: Music = honda-s2000_track.mp3 (generated for this reel by the coordinating session, ElevenLabs via Higgsfield). Measured 138.05 BPM, beat 0.43463 s, first kick 0.0565 s (kick-band peaks + least-squares grid, 5.7 ms sd); ive beats' 92 BPM is the 2/3 dotted feel of the breakbeat
why: Lesson: anchor the grid on kick peaks; the detector's 0.650 s period does not line up with the kicks (sixteenths every 0.217 s = 138 BPM)

decision: Song map: groove beats 0-27, drums drop out 28-31 (12.23 s), DROP on beat 32 (13.965 s), groove to 64, drumless rising outro 65-83, hard stop beat 84 (36.565 s), reverb tail to ~38.4 s (-20 dB), silent ~38.9
why: Per-beat RMS / kick-band table (tools/music_grid.py); the parent's ~36.5 s end = the hard stop, the tail is usable under the logo

decision: Cuts on bar lines (4 beats): 3.534 s (b8), 7.011 (b16), 8.749 (b20), 10.488 (b24), 12.226 (b28 drums out), 15.703 (b36), 18.311 (b42), 20.919 (b48), logo 34.827 (b80); front-open shot starts in the drums-out break with the bumper sliding off and the hood lifts ON the drop (b32); explode separates b49, drifts through the rising outro, slams home b76, logo on b80 through the stop and tail
why: Cut on accents: section changes and bar downbeats; hits land on motion keys where a cut would break the shot (Ferrari approach); varied holds 1-8 bars per the pacing lesson

decision: Added s4b: 2 mm glide along the left flank (mirror, door handle, fender S2000 badge)
why: Fills bar 24-28 with a third extreme close-up instead of over-holding a lamp; the badge is scanned geometry, not added text

decision: v2 assembled with tools/concat_assemble.py (exact frame counts per clip, plain concat) instead of ive assemble; s1 starts 1.4 s into its render
why: v1 check: every cut frame repeated clip A's last frame (frame diff 0.0 before each cut) and dropped B's first - ive assemble builds a cut as a 1-frame xfade over a cloned hold frame. Rubric 9: no dup frames at cuts. Cuts were already within 16 ms of the kicks. s1's first 0.8 s barely moved (diff <0.3) - weak hook

decision: s8 explode re-rendered with use_persistent_data off; drift now 16 % outward with a 6/4-deg extra tilt, orbit 28->78 deg with the aim point sliding toward the nose
why: v2 check: s8 frames 17-211 rendered unlit (black silhouettes; same frame renders fine on its own -> persistent-data fault in the long 4-object animation; render time fell 4.4 -> 1.7 s/frame). Also the 8 s float measured as near-zero frame difference - read as a freeze

decision: Delivered v3 (38.4 s, 1152 frames): concat assembly, s8 re-rendered
why: v1/v2 failed own checks (dup cut frames; unlit s8); v3 passes cutcheck (all cuts within half a frame of the kick grid) and the dark-frame scan

decision: v4: the 13.9 s exploded shot is cut into 4-8 beat shots on bar lines - e1 separation (s8 render b48-52), e2 side high b52-56, e3 low front b56-60, e4 floating-hood close-up b60-64, e5 high rear b64-68, e6 return (s8 render b68-76, ends on the lock), e8 push-in on the locked car b76-80; logo b80 to 37.2 s (2.4 s instead of 3.6)
why: Reviewer: 'the beginning is great, last scenes are held too long'. The front half averages 2.3 s per shot; v3's back half was one 13.9 s shot + 3.6 s logo. Sub-shots render windows (t0) of the same part animation so the explode stays continuous across cuts

decision: Reviewer asked to open with real footage of the S2000 being scanned (their YouTube video 'How to: Scan A Car for Engineering!', youtu.be/03-tWfXkqno) + a 1:1 cut to the scan. No S2000 dump folder on Dropbox; YouTube blocked from this environment (proxy 403 + bot check); Camera Uploads 'S2000' hits are CGI renders of a yellow winged S2000, not footage
why: Cannot do the 1:1 cut without the raw clip; asked the user to drop the source clip into Dropbox. Meanwhile v4 (pacing fix) proceeds scan-only

decision: Delivered v4 (37.2 s): back half re-cut into 4-8 beat shots, logo 2.4 s
why: Reviewer feedback: last scenes held too long; cutcheck: 15 cuts within 16 ms

decision: v5: withdrew everything built from 'S2000 trunk.stl' - trunk-opening shot s6 replaced by s6_structure (look into the real Bumper Removed / Hood Open structure), trunk lid removed from the exploded view (base = comp_fronthood: only bumper + hood come off, rear stays as scanned), lid-focused e5_rear replaced by e5_fronthigh
why: Reviewer: 'Rear trunk data is made-up. If there's no actual trunk open scan, don't cut it incorrectly' (promoted to a rule). Only the front-end states (Bumper Only / Bumper Removed / Hood Open) are real state scans of this car

decision: Received the all-reels v2 brief from the coordinating session (user: 'All V1 videos need the same updates'); stopped the v5 render queue after s6_structure; ran ive director on v4; direction.md/director.md being written before any new render
why: Brief: order by scan features with front->side->rear travel, part-focused explode (no single wide orbit), no redundant views, whole-car opening, fade + small logo, never imply missing data; render nothing new before direction.md
